body.x: EDENLUX will be exhibiting at MIKINNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT (BOOTH) in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, theworld's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) #52843) to show the visual improvement device 'Otus'.

EDENLUX was founded with the goalof bringing together doctors and optical technology experts to help improve thevision of mankind around the world. After a long period of research andclinical trials, the company succeeded in developing Otus, a vision-enhancingdevice capable of IoT-based self-vision management and vision training. Inaddition, EDENLUX aims to contribute to improving the average visual acuity ofhuman beings through prevention and prediction of human eye disease, whichanalyzes not only product sales but also sight data received from users.

Otus is a product that can easilymanage eyesight at home and has a special optical lens inserted. A trainingalgorithm based on this strengthens the eye muscles and helps to improveessential vision. This product can also perform a self-vision-check through theapplication and Bluetooth interface, and establishes a long-term visionmanagement roadmap based on this. We also offer customized training programs.Users can conduct daily activities such as watching television or reading bookson an open screen, and can do sight training.

In addition, Otus has beenapproved for myopia and presbyopia through clinical trials, and has theadvantage of being able to quickly enter the market with FDA approval forwellness products, not medical devices.

EDENLUX aims to advance into theUS, China, Japan, Vietnam and India. The company will participate in 2019 CESwith Changwon Industry Promotion Agency and conduct a survey of customers andcompetitors in the US market. EDENLUX is the world's first visual managementdevice developed at CES.

EDENLUX, which is going tostrengthen its managerial side based on the difference of "customizedtraining" provided through the link with the app, plans to make addedvalue based on professional data of eyesight, not just sales of devices. It alsoaims to improve vision of all human beings by providing practical informationsuch as eyeglass replacement time by tracking eye disease and sight changetrend through sight measurement.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technologycompanies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate.
